name: First Fix
meaning: You went back to something you got wrong instead of moving on. That's where real improvement starts.

name: Mark Hunter
description: Fix the mistakes behind 10 lost marks
meaning: You found 10 marks you lost in your own exam papers, and fixed what cost you them.

name: Mark Collector
description: Fix the mistakes behind 25 lost marks
meaning: You've gone back through 25 marks of your own mistakes, one chapter at a time.

name: Mark Master
description: Fix the mistakes behind 50 lost marks
meaning: You've worked through 50 marks of your own mistakes. That's a lot of honest review.

name: Comeback
description: Pass a chapter you failed before
meaning: You didn't pass, you came back, and you got it.

name: First-Try Fix
description: Score 100% on a chapter's first attempt
meaning: You reviewed your mistakes so well that you got every question right the first time.

name: Remediation Finisher
description: Finish all weak chapters in a subject
meaning: Every weak chapter from that exam is done. You closed the whole list, not just the easy ones.

name: Quiz Champion
description: Get every question right in a solo quiz
meaning: A full quiz with no mistakes means you know that chapter, not just part of it.

name: Team Victory
description: Win a team battle with two friends
meaning: Three of you talked it through, agreed on answers and beat another team. Good teams explain, not just answer.

name: Dream Team
description: Get every question right in a team battle
meaning: A perfect battle. Every answer your team agreed on was right, from the first question to the boss round.

name: Plan Keeper
meaning: You made a plan and stuck to it, five times over.

name: On a Roll
description: Finish a quiz or assessment 3 days in a row
meaning: Three days running. This is how a study habit starts.

name: Week Warrior
description: Finish a quiz or assessment 7 days in a row
meaning: A full week of study, every single day.

name: Starter
meaning: Your first points on the board.

name: Achiever
meaning: You're making practice a regular thing.

name: Champion
meaning: You've put in enough practice to reach the top points milestone.
